title: An Algebraic Proof of the Non-Modularity of Solutions to the Canonical Modular Differential Equation
summary: In this paper, we provide an algebraic proof of the condition for the existence of modular form solutions to the Kaneko-Zagier differential equation of weight $k$. Unlike previous representation-theoretic approaches relying on $SL_2(\mathbb{Z})$, our method employs the connection matrices of the principal congruence subgroup $Γ(N)$.
